## Definition of done

- [ ] The behaviour is covered by tests (acceptance for flows, unit for rules)
- [ ] `npm run check` is green
- [ ] Public code and non-obvious decisions are documented, with the specification section cited
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` is updated if a rule, a flow or the architecture changed
- [ ] A contract change was copied from Clavia and the types regenerated (`npm run contract`)
- [ ] The page works in light and dark mode, at phone width and by keyboard
